title: Governed half-open recovery of quarantined capabilities
source: opossum 10.0.0 (nodeshift/opossum), lib/circuit.js — analysed with REA, read in source
existing GREG precursor: greg/models.py route demotion with cooldown
source_version_and_license: opossum 10.0.0, Apache-2.0, tarball sha256 6bc54f2dff664f33bafd82d2a60e98b581a2e74461a9095ee5a675f59cb9c637; no code copied
observed_behavior: after a failure threshold the breaker opens; a fixed resetTimeout timer moves it to half-open; the next live call is the probe; success closes, failure re-opens and restarts the same timer
underlying_function: time-delayed, evidence-gated re-admission of a component that was excluded for failing
state_and_transitions: CLOSED -> OPEN (threshold) -> HALF_OPEN (timer) -> CLOSED (probe success) | OPEN (probe failure)

inputs_and_outputs.out: state transitions and events (open, halfOpen, close, failure)

resource_consumption: one timer per breaker; the probe is a real call
feedback_loops: failure in half-open immediately re-opens; no growth of the wait
selection_rules: volumeThreshold and errorThresholdPercentage decide opening; any single half-open success closes
trust_and_authority_boundaries: none: the component re-enters service on one live success
failure_behavior: a flapping dependency re-enters and fails repeatedly at a fixed cadence; the probe consumes a live request
evidence_and_uncertainties: REA evidence ev_bda547f2…781b (static, inert parse; 2,708 unresolved dynamic calls package-wide); confirmed by reading lib/circuit.js; runtime not observed
candidate_transformation: probe in the sandbox on a fresh frozen-oracle seed (counterfactual, never live work); success restores eligibility (VERIFIED) never authority (ATTACHED); exponential backoff per failed probe and per prior quarantine; flapping stops recovery for the founder; dependency-ordered probing (engines before constructions, a construction probes through its own pinned engine)
new_failure_risk: a component that passes the oracle but fails on live inputs can be re-admitted; bounded by the flapping stop (more than 3 in-service quarantines) and by founder-or-scope attach
intended_greg_capability: a function lost to transient faults returns without founder attention, under the mission's own signed scope
independent_verifier: the capability's own frozen oracle (brute force / certificate) in an isolated interpreter, fresh seed per attempt
integration_interface: Genesis.recover(now) each Body tick; MissionEngine re-admits once per recovery through Genesis.resolve (verified_detached route)
replacement_and_rollback: revert the commit; recovery writes only capability.probe, capability.state VERIFIED and capability.recovery_stopped facts; the founder can detach any recovered capability
